messages.subject: RE: Remediation plan - first draft for the HSE
messages.plaintextBody:
Gail,

My mark-up (v2) is done. The HSE indicated on 19 February they want firmer commitments, so I've: tightened function-test intervals from six months to four; added CEO-level escalation for tasks overdue more than 14 days; added a long-stop of 30 September 2026 to complete the switch replacement programme; moved board review of the register to every two months until remediation is complete; and committed to monthly written progress reports. These strengthen our mitigation. Please review with Derek; once agreed we'll prepare a clean version for signature.

Tom

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
